firstFinal:
Commit 20f03a431 changed no test results in the file I compared, but I didn't compare every file the change could affect.

- **What the commit touched:** `src/core/store/mark.ts` and `test/store/open.test.ts`. The test file gained 27 lines.
- **Result I checked:** `test/store/open.test.ts` passes at 20f03a431 and also passed at its parent a5c9b7223 (`squeal status --at 20f03a4~1`). So it did not go from fail to pass, and I found no file that changed result.
- **What I didn't check:** Squeal says the `mark.ts` change selects 1338 test files. Their runs at a5c9b7223 were still queued or running when I stopped, so I have no comparison for them. A pass/fail change in one of them would not show up in what I've reported.

`squeal status --at '20f03a4~1' --wait 300000` will finish the full comparison once those runs end. I can run it if you want the complete answer.

One caveat on the "unchanged" line: the parent's version of `open.test.ts` is the one that ran at a5c9b7223. It lacks the 27 new test lines, so "pass -> pass" means the file passes both times, not that the same tests ran.
